player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly picked up and dropped items to make space in my inventory, wasting turns and losing track of my location while searching for the missing ingredient (peach). I should have managed my inventory capacity proactively by dropping items immediately after taking them, rather than hoarding them. Furthermore, I got lost in the loop between the magic workshop, kitchen, and conservatory due to gravity mechanics; I need to map the specific locations of the wand and the peach more carefully before attempting to brew. Finally, I must ensure I have all six ingredients (ectoplasm, peach, zulpowand, fairy wand, eye of newt, spider egg) and the cauldron before attempting to follow the recipe steps.
